reviewer_note: Candidates identified and license-verified via their public GitHub pages. Code is NOT vendored into this repository: only provenance metadata is recorded here. Copyleft (GPL/AGPL), custom/unknown, and different-solver sources are reference-only and must never be copied, adapted, linked, or imported into the framework. Permissive (MIT/BSD-3/Apache) sources may be vendored later WITH attribution and license retention, but are not required for any offline test.

acquisition_policy.reason: license-safe cataloguing; avoids copying restricted/unknown code and keeps the permissive core clean

diversity_note: Deliberately not crystal-plasticity-only. Covers linear/finite elasticity, hyperelasticity, J2 plasticity, viscoelasticity, damage, cohesive, and coupled chemo-mechanics; UELs span 2D/3D continuum, Cosserat, coupled-field, and cohesive.

candidates.name: umat_finite_viscoelasticity
candidates.next_missing_item: an exported ODB stress field (Mode 1) OR a compiled UMAT via ifort+Abaqus (Mode 2); history-dependent so full increment sequence required
candidates.notes: Ogden hyperelastic base + relaxation mechanisms; history-dependent (viscoelastic).

candidates.name: UMAT4COMSOL
candidates.next_missing_item: an Abaqus .inp single-element test must be authored (repo ships COMSOL-oriented result_files, not Abaqus .inp); then compiled UMAT or exported stress
candidates.notes: Provides a clean standard-format J2 elastoplastic UMAT (elastoplastic/ dir) — the diverse plasticity example that is NOT crystal plasticity.

candidates.name: UMAT_Hyperelastic (Neo-Hookean)

candidates.notes: Clean analytically-validated Neo-Hookean reference; has simple-shear/extension .inp. Reference only due to GPL-3.0.

candidates.name: Bilinear-CZM-UMAT
